{{Top|leg}}
The '''High Temple of Eeronon''' was a massive wooden structure located at the center of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Talerakia]]. Richly decorated, it was the center of the [[Aramandi]]'s religion, known as [[Eeronon]].
